title: OTHRYS OS evidence-native Progress and Plan interaction
goal: Make Progress and Plan genuinely navigable from canonical mission evidence without adding execution or transition authority.
laws: Mission detail is derived from missions/*.json and *.result.json only.
Recent mission selection may change visible detail but never active authority.
Progress and Plan are distinct read-only projections of the same mission evidence.
PASS, candidate SHA and result presence must be visible when recorded.
No chat, model, shell, transition, accept, reject or release execution endpoint is added.
Existing Refine intent boundary remains unchanged.
Tablet-first interaction remains touch usable and local.
